result_scoring.pass: All required columns and rows match the reference under per-column comparison rules.
result_scoring.column_order: May reorder columns using declared names; missing, duplicate or unexpected names fail.
result_scoring.row_order: Enforced for daily/monthly/grouped/ranked questions; scalar questions have one row.
result_scoring.duplicates: Preserve multiplicity; do not turn rows into a set.
result_scoring.null: JSON null only; distinct from zero, empty string and text NULL.
result_scoring.count_and_amount_tolerance: 0: exact numeric equality, no display rounding.
result_scoring.division_tolerance: absolute 0.000001, fractions not percentages; no automatic x100 conversion.
result_scoring.failures: Timeout, execution failure, missing result or wrong refusal count as failures in the fixed denominator.
result_scoring.row_cap: Reference results <=1000 rows. Do not truncate submitted results to manufacture a match.

business_scoring.pass: All necessary R01..Rn rules pass against the actual executed SQL and execution trace.
business_scoring.rule_ids: One-based positions in each private case.required_rules.
business_scoring.evidence: Every rule needs a boolean verdict and concrete SQL/trace evidence; reviewer and executed_sql_evidence required.
business_scoring.reviewer: Human review for verified accuracy. LLM Judge alone is provisional and must be labeled.
business_scoring.unreviewed: Pending, not silently passed or discarded; withhold aggregate verified business accuracy until all 400 are resolved.
business_scoring.execution_failures: Count as business failures; fixed denominator remains 400.
business_scoring.important: Correct numeric output does not prove correct business semantics; value coincidence must not pass a wrong formula.

reporting.delta: B minus A in percentage points
reporting.template_dependence: 25 formal families with 20 parameter variants each. Use family-clustered uncertainty if reporting intervals; not 500 independent business scenarios.

experiment.off: No v1 business Evidence; same physical Schema, model, retry budget and pipeline.
experiment.on: Retrieve from frozen knowledge-v1 package; do not attach gold definitions per question.
experiment.isolation: New conversation per question, no dev-to-test context/cache leakage.
experiment.test_use: Freeze before model tuning; changes to questions or scoring require a new version and rerunning both groups.
